# Bachelorette Pole Dancing Parties

> Las Vegas bachelorette pole dancing parties — private pole and chair dance instruction from real Las Vegas entertainers, with special treatment for the bride.

Hosted at Pole Fitness Studio, Las Vegas. $40 per guest, 6-guest minimum, 75-minute parties. Booking via polefitnessstudio.com or 702-878-7653.

## Pages

- [Party Packages](/party-package): Pricing, inclusions and FAQs
- [Reviews](/reviews): What brides say
- [About](/about): Who we are
- [Contact](/contact): Reserve your party

## Related sites

- [TASTE The Show](https://tastetheshow.com/): Las Vegas pole, burlesque, contortion and variety show produced by Fawnia Mondey
- [Pole Fitness Studio](https://www.polefitnessstudio.com): Las Vegas pole dance, aerial and fitness studio founded by Fawnia
- [Pole Fitness Online](https://www.polefitnessonline.com): online pole dance classes
- [Officially Fawnia](https://officiallyfawnia.com): official site of pole pioneer Fawnia Mondey Dietrich
- [Burlesque To Go](https://burlesquetogo.com): burlesque dancers delivered to your Las Vegas event
- [Las Vegas Pole Rentals](https://lasvegaspolerentals.com): portable dance pole rentals in Las Vegas
- [I Love Pole Because](https://ilovepolebecause.com): community stories about why people love pole dancing
- [The Melissa Foundation](https://themelissafoundation.org): nonprofit sharing health and wellness resources for people before, during and after cancer
